panels.title: Collection adoption history
panels.description: hourly snapshots begin when the sanitized exporter is deployed

targets.queryText: SELECT CAST(strftime('%s', snapshot_at) AS INTEGER) AS t, max(CASE WHEN metric = 'collection_collectors' THEN value END) AS collectors, max(CASE WHEN metric = 'collection_cards' THEN value END) AS unique_cards FROM hub_metric_snapshots WHERE metric IN ('collection_collectors', 'collection_cards') AND CAST(strftime('%s', snapshot_at) AS INTEGER) > $__from / 1000 AND CAST(strftime('%s', snapshot_at) AS INTEGER) <= $__to / 1000 GROUP BY snapshot_at ORDER BY snapshot_at
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT CAST(strftime('%s', snapshot_at) AS INTEGER) AS t, max(CASE WHEN metric = 'collection_collectors' THEN value END) AS collectors, max(CASE WHEN metric = 'collection_cards' THEN value END) AS unique_cards FROM hub_metric_snapshots WHERE metric IN ('collection_collectors', 'collection_cards') AND CAST(strftime('%s', snapshot_at) AS INTEGER) > $__from / 1000 AND CAST(strftime('%s', snapshot_at) AS INTEGER) <= $__to / 1000 GROUP BY snapshot_at ORDER BY snapshot_at

panels.title: Deck creation and publication
panels.description: daily user deck creation and Deck Hub publication

targets.queryText: SELECT CAST(strftime('%s', day) AS INTEGER) AS t, sum(CASE WHEN metric = 'decks_created' AND dimension = 'user' THEN value ELSE 0 END) AS user_decks, sum(CASE WHEN metric = 'publications_created' AND dimension = 'published' THEN value ELSE 0 END) AS publications, sum(CASE WHEN metric = 'favorites_created' THEN value ELSE 0 END) AS favorites FROM hub_daily_metrics WHERE CAST(strftime('%s', day) AS INTEGER) > $__from / 1000 AND CAST(strftime('%s', day) AS INTEGER) <= $__to / 1000 GROUP BY day ORDER BY day
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT CAST(strftime('%s', day) AS INTEGER) AS t, sum(CASE WHEN metric = 'decks_created' AND dimension = 'user' THEN value ELSE 0 END) AS user_decks, sum(CASE WHEN metric = 'publications_created' AND dimension = 'published' THEN value ELSE 0 END) AS publications, sum(CASE WHEN metric = 'favorites_created' THEN value ELSE 0 END) AS favorites FROM hub_daily_metrics WHERE CAST(strftime('%s', day) AS INTEGER) > $__from / 1000 AND CAST(strftime('%s', day) AS INTEGER) <= $__to / 1000 GROUP BY day ORDER BY day

panels.title: Published-deck engagement
panels.description: daily play, completion, and win evidence; counts are deck-seat reports, not unique games

targets.queryText: SELECT CAST(strftime('%s', day) AS INTEGER) AS t, sum(CASE WHEN metric = 'plays' THEN value ELSE 0 END) AS plays, sum(CASE WHEN metric = 'completed_plays' THEN value ELSE 0 END) AS completed, sum(CASE WHEN metric = 'wins' THEN value ELSE 0 END) AS wins FROM hub_daily_metrics WHERE CAST(strftime('%s', day) AS INTEGER) > $__from / 1000 AND CAST(strftime('%s', day) AS INTEGER) <= $__to / 1000 GROUP BY day ORDER BY day
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT CAST(strftime('%s', day) AS INTEGER) AS t, sum(CASE WHEN metric = 'plays' THEN value ELSE 0 END) AS plays, sum(CASE WHEN metric = 'completed_plays' THEN value ELSE 0 END) AS completed, sum(CASE WHEN metric = 'wins' THEN value ELSE 0 END) AS wins FROM hub_daily_metrics WHERE CAST(strftime('%s', day) AS INTEGER) > $__from / 1000 AND CAST(strftime('%s', day) AS INTEGER) <= $__to / 1000 GROUP BY day ORDER BY day

panels.title: What do people build and own?
Collection sizes
panels.description: privacy-safe account buckets; no individual collection is exported

targets.queryText: SELECT dimension AS size, value AS collectors FROM hub_metric_snapshots WHERE metric = 'collection_size_buckets' AND snapshot_at = (SELECT max(snapshot_at) FROM hub_metric_snapshots) ORDER BY CASE dimension WHEN '<100' THEN 1 WHEN '100-499' THEN 2 WHEN '500-999' THEN 3 WHEN '1k-5k' THEN 4 ELSE 5 END
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT dimension AS size, value AS collectors FROM hub_metric_snapshots WHERE metric = 'collection_size_buckets' AND snapshot_at = (SELECT max(snapshot_at) FROM hub_metric_snapshots) ORDER BY CASE dimension WHEN '<100' THEN 1 WHEN '100-499' THEN 2 WHEN '500-999' THEN 3 WHEN '1k-5k' THEN 4 ELSE 5 END

targets.queryText: SELECT dimension AS format, value AS decks FROM hub_metric_snapshots WHERE metric = 'decks_by_format' AND snapshot_at = (SELECT max(snapshot_at) FROM hub_metric_snapshots) ORDER BY decks DESC
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT dimension AS format, value AS decks FROM hub_metric_snapshots WHERE metric = 'decks_by_format' AND snapshot_at = (SELECT max(snapshot_at) FROM hub_metric_snapshots) ORDER BY decks DESC
